backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing resume analysis system with job role management, resume upload/comparison, skill gap analysis, scoring algorithms, and access control using mixins for authorization and blob storage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining data type schemas (WorkExperience, Education, Skill, JobRole, Resume, UserProfile, ResumeData) and a pass-through migration function for actor upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including comprehensive result page, scoring breakdown display, skill match/gap visualization, and actionable recommendations with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components and pages including routing, authentication, profile management, analysis workflow, admin panel, and visualization components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, borders, charts, sidebar).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting point for the AI-Based Skill Gap Analyzer application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analysis flow, dashboard, admin panel, resume upload/results, and comprehensive result page; includes authentication state management, profile setup modal, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying shield alert icon and message for unauthorized users attempting to access admin-restricted pages with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions via useIsCallerAdmin hook and renders children only for authorized admins, otherwise displays AccessDeniedScreen.
frontend/src/components/CompareResumesVi: Displays a side-by-side comparison of multiple resumes, showing overall scores and metrics like experience level, education count, skill count, and certifications for each resume.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteDia: A confirmation dialog component for deleting resumes, displaying the resume name and providing cancel/confirm actions with loading state support.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that generates and downloads a personalized PDF analysis report containing job role match data, skills, and recommendations.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Displays skill gap analysis results in two cards showing matching skills (with proficiency levels) and missing/insufficient skills, categorized by technical and soft skills.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing job roles with title, description, and required skills (with proficiency levels and categories), supporting both add and update operations.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleMatchResu: Displays job role compatibility results sorted by match percentage, showing compatibility scores, matching/missing skills counts, and a button to view detailed analysis for each role.
Radio group selector for choosing a job role from available options, displaying each role with its required skills as badges with proficiency level indicators.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header, navigation menu (Analyze, Admin, Resume Upload), authentication state handling, and responsive mobile menu. Includes role-based navigation visibility for admin users.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states. Clears query cache on logout and handles authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Bar chart component using Recharts to visualize skill proficiency distribution (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced) comparing matching vs missing skills.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile creation with fields for name (required), email, education, and experience. Cannot be dismissed until profile is created.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for missing skills, including course suggestions with external links and practice project ideas organized by skill.
frontend/src/components/ResumeList.tsx: Lists user's uploaded resumes with metadata (skills, experience, education counts), supports selection and deletion with confirmation dialog. Shows loading states and empty state messaging.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: Handles PDF resume upload with validation (file type, size), parses resume content using NLP service, extracts skills, validates required sections (experience, skills, education), and converts data to backend format before upload.
frontend/src/components/ScoreBreakdown.t: Displays a detailed resume score breakdown with an overall score circle, category-specific scores (completeness, content quality, formatting, impact) with progress bars, and feedback items with icons.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Renders a bar chart comparing matching vs. missing skills across technical and soft skill categories using Recharts.
Displays a pie chart showing the proportion of matching skills to missing skills using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/SkillMatchGapDis: Shows a comprehensive skill gap analysis with matching, missing, and insufficient proficiency skills organized by technical and soft skill categories, each with status icons and proficiency indicators.
Renders categorized skill badges (technical, soft, domain) with proficiency level indicators using color-coded dots and borders.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, handling identity changes and invalidating dependent queries when the actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing auth client creation, identity state, and login status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, job roles (CRUD operations), and resume management with mutations that invalidate caches and show toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useResumeAnalysis.ts: Provides a mutation hook that parses a resume file with AI, saves extracted data to the backend, and uploads the file blob with progress tracking (0-100%).
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a warm, education-focused color palette (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent) supporting both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page for managing job roles with CRUD operations, displaying required skills with proficiency badges, and confirmation dialogs for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Displays comprehensive skill analysis results including match charts, gap analysis, and recommendations based on job role comparison with parsed resume data passed via router state.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Main analysis workflow page with tabs for uploading or selecting resumes, calculating job role matches, and navigating to detailed analysis with authentication guards.
frontend/src/pages/ComprehensiveResultPa: Main results page displaying comprehensive resume analysis including score breakdown, skill categorization, gap analysis, recommendations, and comparison features. Supports editing resume data, downloading PDF reports, and comparing multiple resumes.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards explaining the four-step process: upload resume, select job role, get analysis, and receive recommendations. Conditionally shows 'Start Analysis' button for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeResultsPage.tsx: Admin-only page displaying detailed resume analysis results including resume score, categorized skills, contact information, work experience, education, and certifications. Uses AdminGuard for access control.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeUploadPage.tsx: Admin-only page for uploading resume files (PDF, JPG, PNG) with drag-and-drop support, file validation, progress tracking, and navigation to comprehensive results after successful analysis.
frontend/src/services/aiResumeParser.ts: Service that converts uploaded resume files to bytes and delegates to NLP service for comprehensive data extraction, returning structured ParsedResumeData with contact info, skills, experience, education, and certifications.
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Service that compares extracted resume skills against job role requirements to identify missing skills, matching skills, and skills with insufficient proficiency levels. Includes resume context like experience and education in results.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Defines types for resume data (comprehensive, parsed, work experience, education, certifications) and provides functions to extract text from PDF bytes, parse contact info, professional summaries, and other resume sections using pattern matching and text analysis.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Generates downloadable text-based skill gap analysis reports including job role match percentage, matching/missing skills, personalized recommendations, and candidate profile data (experience, education, certifications) formatted for download as a blob.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Provides personalized course and project recommendations for missing skills using hardcoded databases mapping skills (JavaScript, Python, React, SQL, ML, Docker, Kubernetes) to relevant courses from Udemy/Coursera/freeCodeCamp and suggested practice projects.
frontend/src/services/resumeScoring.ts: Calculates a comprehensive resume score (0-100) across four dimensions: completeness (name, contact, experience, education, skills), content quality (experience duration, career progression), formatting, and skill relevance, returning scores with detailed feedback for each category.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts and categorizes skills from parsed resume data into technical, soft, and domain categories using a hardcoded skills database, and calculates experience level (entry/mid/senior/expert) and total years of experience from work history durations.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Implements skill matching algorithms that compare resume skills against job role requirements, calculating match percentages and identifying matching/missing skills with proficiency level consideration.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH, typography, animations, and design tokens for the application's styling system.
project_state.json: Project state document tracking the resume analyzer application's features including extraction, scoring, result display, skill matching, recommendations, editing, PDF generation, and multi-resume comparison functionality.
